title: Announcing Amazon Textract Insights: Verifiable generative AI for documents
summary: Announcing the general availability of Amazon Textract Insights, a new generative AI feature of Amazon Textract. Describe the fields you need in natural language, submit a document or a mixed packet, and receive structured results with a confidence score and page-level grounding
reason: Amazon Textract Insights is a new generative AI feature/GA product launch, not a named model release. AWS's own blog announcement on aws.amazon.com fits rule 3-1 for a non-model product launch by a company.
